==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I found myself trapped flying inside of what appeared to be a wormhole. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (The wormhole resembled an endless swirling glowing blue tunnel covered in sparkling lights resembling twinkling stars.)

I tried to speed through it to get back to the Elven Village, but the wormhole seemed to be an infinite loop.

I couldn't even make portals to escape, so I had to tear it open with my bare hands glowing with Lucid Light to escape back to the Elven Village.
